headline: Launch: 27 offers, UK deadlines this week
highlights: EY-Parthenon London strategy graduate scheme closes on 22 Oct, L.E.K. London on 25 Oct, OC&C on 1 Nov.

headline: 50 new offers; Kearney London closes tomorrow

Best fits for you: Bouygues Construction Corporate Strategy Intern (low-carbon and waste-diversion agenda), Edenred Group Strategy Intern, and Ardian Corporate Development intern (March 2027).

headline: 39 new offers; next UK deadlines on 20 November
